name: asset-criticality
description: How important the affected host is. High or critical raises the case severity by one level (docs/ALERT-FORMAT.md).

name: containment-action
description: Response action taken. Set by an n8n playbook for automated actions (C9, Phase 2): ip-blocked (firewall-drop / host-deny), user-disabled (disable-account). host-isolated and file-removed are manual-only until Wazuh has custom active-response scripts: set by the analyst, with a case comment.

name: mitre-technique
description: Main ATT&CK technique ID, e.g. T1110 (from Wazuh rule.mitre.id).

name: n8n-execution-id
description: ID of the n8n execution that created or updated this record (traceability, PROJECT.md 6.2).

name: playbook
description: n8n playbook that handled the alert (pb-<use-case>).

name: wazuh-agent-name
description: Name of the Wazuh agent (host) that produced the alert (agent.name).

name: wazuh-alert-id
description: Wazuh alert ID (the alert's id field): links the record back to Wazuh and Grafana.

name: wazuh-rule-level
description: Wazuh rule level, 0-15 (rule.level); mapped to severity in docs/ALERT-FORMAT.md.
